title: 知识准备失败后首次真实 Coder 的恢复种子准入
problem: FirstCoderRunWorkspaceAdmission 按 request.attempt>1 跳过准入；知识准备失败也会推进执行身份，因此首次实际 Coder 可能仍未消费恢复种子准入。
scope: 知识准备与主Coder执行分开：真实claim与完整durable main facts选择seed或normal input gate
原seed与旧replacement在fresh adapter/progress/QA返工中保持一次性，不补造旧receipt
两provider准入拒绝统一typed WORK_INTERRUPTED并透传ownership/unknown/wait控制信号
只做fake provider、真实临时Git及隔离MySQL增量验证；不操作生产事实
acceptance: 知识-only失败后首个main Coder即使attempt>1仍核验原批准、sealed Task和seed
先前已真实准入并完成的Coder使用正常progress/candidate检查，不重放seed
已有start无结果不能视为未执行或补造recovery invocation
仅增量测试，不停当前合法Coder，不改SQL、旧审批或执行记录
verification: ruff check/format --check on all owned Python files
mypy --strict on all 15 owned Python files
pytest tests/agents/test_first_real_coder_admission.py: zero provider calls and typed errors/control signals
Selected isolated MySQL tests/recovery/test_execution.py cases; legacy fixture failures require independent baseline comparison
Independent source/spec and incremental regression review before commit
rollback: Revert the scoped code commit before new execution; unchanged wire schema requires no data migration. Preserve any real new admission receipt and all old missing/unknown facts.
